svg.title: Waypoint canonical feature mockups
svg.desc: Supporting visual contract for the sole Waypoint Design Authority. It shows canonical composition for Atlas, Trip, Itinerary mobile and desktop, Map mobile and desktop, Guide, Split, Search, and SOS. It is not an independent design authority.
svg.metadata: WAYPOINT CANONICAL FEATURE MOCKUPS — SUPPORTING FIGURE ONLY. Governing authority: docs/reference/design-system.md. If this figure conflicts with the Markdown authority, the Markdown authority wins. Binding traits: hierarchy, relative scale, navigation form, panel relationships, responsive composition, hero prominence, density limits, map/sheet behavior, typography wrapping, and placement of key states/actions. Illustrative only: exact photographs, copy, monetary amounts, times, map geometry, pin names, route labels, and decorative micro-detail. Fable/Claude/Codex must not average this board with superseded D1–D7 experiments or component-gallery screenshots.
svg.text: WAYPOINT · CANONICAL FEATURE MOCKUPS · SUPPORTING FIGURE
One visual contract for Fable 5.1 implementation
Governed by docs/reference/design-system.md · hierarchy and composition are binding · exact sample content is illustrative.

g.text: Atlas is geography-first. Controls float; no flat admin sidebar.
What matters now, not the whole trip dossier.
No “Add to plan” on a finished trip.
The timeline remains dominant; imagery and route context support it.
Parallel party branches become readable sections and reconverge at a shared anchor.
Use the real route/ticket action or leave the slot empty.
Default ≈55/45; user-resizable 30–70. Temporal ↔ spatial continuity is the point.
Context rises from a bottom sheet; the map never becomes a dead backdrop.
Render intentional cartography, canonical pins and cached context—not a blank pale plane.
Live turn-by-turn hands off to the native provider.
Hangul is an acceptance test. Tofu squares are a hard failure.
An editorial front door to practical, traceable travel knowledge.
Traveler anchor, not the whole IA
Normal word wrapping is binding. Never force “Ess ent ials” / per-character headings.
Recent expenses first; settlement is secondary.
Every row states the split method in words.
Dismiss returns to the exact prior surface and scroll position.
Search is traveler-facing infrastructure, not a developer command palette or AI-chat answer engine.
Verified essentials first. Core numbers work offline.
No symptom triage, fake responder orchestration, or “help request sent” theater.
hierarchy · relative scale · responsive composition · panel relationships · hero prominence · density · map/sheet behavior · typography wrapping · key-state placement.
exact photo subject · sample copy/data · prices · times · route geometry · pin labels · decorative micro-detail.
Do not average this board with superseded mockups or the D7 component-gallery screenshots.
